import numpy as np
edges=np.arange(0.2,4.01,0.3)
for lo in edges:
    m=(A>=lo)&(A<lo+0.3)
    if m.sum()<8: continue
    Ab=A[m].mean()
    X=np.column_stack([np.ones(m.sum()),t[m],t[m]**2])
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dA_dt[m],rcond=None)[0]
    r=np.std(X@c-dA_dt[m])
    X2=np.column_stack([np.ones(m.sum()),t[m],np.sqrt(t[m])])
    c2=np.linalg.lstsq(X2,dA_dt[m],rcond=None)[0]
    r2=np.std(X2@c2-dA_dt[m])
    print(f"A~{Ab:.2f} n={m.sum()} quad: {np.round(c,3)} res {r:.2e} | sqrt: {np.round(c2,3)} res {r2:.2e}")
